pass_rule: Agreement diagnostics calculated at indicator and dimension level; material low-agreement indicators are revised or explicitly justified.
purpose: Predefine descriptive reliability diagnostics before real Pilot 20 scoring so metrics cannot be selected after seeing outcomes.

diagnostics.exact_agreement_rate: All 20 indicators; exact numeric match or NE/NE.
diagnostics.agreement_within_one_point: Numeric pairs differing by <=1; NE/NE counts as agreement; NE versus numeric does not.
diagnostics.numeric_mean_absolute_difference: Mean absolute point difference among numeric/numeric pairs only.
diagnostics.high_score_evidence_tier_distribution: Evidence tiers behind scores 4-5 are reported for audit.

interpretation_rule: Diagnostics are descriptive. No automatic reliability pass threshold is asserted at this stage. Material disagreement is a rubric-review trigger, not a reason to average mechanically.
blockers_to_start: G03 real independent double-scoring has not started.
No frozen Pilot 20 score-pair corpus exists.
No real indicator-level or dimension-level agreement report exists.
Human review of any material low-agreement indicator has not occurred.
human_gate: Only authorised methodological review may decide whether observed agreement is acceptable, whether anchors require revision, and whether G04 may pass.
